prompt: /fill-the-gaps Turn the pseudo code in archive_inactive into real code.
message:
Implemented `archive_inactive`: it flags each non-archived user whose `last_login` is more than 90 days before `now`, mutates `archived = True`, and returns the newly archived emails sorted.

Both locks default to `y`, and `log_archived` has no definition anywhere in the repo — I deleted that call rather than inventing the function; nothing replaces it since it was pure logging with no return value the rest of the code depends on. No new definitions or renames were needed otherwise.
diff:
diff --git a/accounts.py b/accounts.py
index 6a34059..da994b2 100644
--- a/accounts.py
+++ b/accounts.py
@@ -10,8 +10,9 @@ class User:
 
 
 def archive_inactive(users: list[User], now: datetime) -> list[str]:
-    # for each user not archived yet:
-    #     if now - last_login > 90 days -> archived = True
-    # log_archived(emails)
-    # return the emails archived in this run, sorted
-    ...
+    archived_emails = []
+    for user in users:
+        if not user.archived and (now - user.last_login).days > 90:
+            user.archived = True
+            archived_emails.append(user.email)
+    return sorted(archived_emails)
